title: Volantis, which aims to use vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers, used in the iPhone's Face ID, to transmit data between AI and memory chips, raised $88M (Stephen Nellis/Reuters)
summary: Stephen Nellis / Reuters: Volantis, which aims to use vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers, used in the iPhone's Face ID, to transmit data between AI and memory chips, raised $88M — San Francisco-based semiconductor startup Volantis on Thursday said it has raised $88 million in venture capital in an effort …
